name: The Sensor-Room Host
effect: Boosting this layer-9 neuron makes the model act like the cheerful host of a live session in a room wired with sensors, microphones and cameras, and it greets the user instead of answering.
source: Found by the overnight screen of all 294,912 neurons; blind judges told it apart from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs (q=1.0e-06).
